GET_USER_GOAL_COUNT_QUERY: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_goals WHERE user_id = %s
CHECK_USER_GOAL_EXISTS_QUERY: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_goals WHERE user_id = %s AND name = %s
INSERT_USER_GOAL_QUERY: INSERT INTO user_goals (user_id, name, target_amount, time_to_reach, image_url, progress_amount, is_active) VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, 1)
UPDATE_USER_GOAL_PROGRESS_QUERY: UPDATE user_goals SET progress_amount = %s WHERE id = %s AND user_id = %s
SELECT_ACTIVE_GOAL_PROGRESS_QUERY: SELECT progress_amount FROM user_goals WHERE user_id = %s AND name = (SELECT savings_goal_name FROM user_onboarding WHERE user_id = %s) LIMIT 1
GET_USER_GOALS_QUERY: SELECT * FROM user_goals WHERE user_id = %s ORDER BY id DESC
DELETE_USER_GOAL_QUERY: DELETE FROM user_goals WHERE id = %s AND user_id = %s
